eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Yakima, WA; at 5:10 PM on AUG 15, 2023 Effective until 1:10 AM AUG 16, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Level 3 "GO NOW" NIVEL 3 (VE AHORA) Evacuation Notice A wildfire is threatening your safety, if you are within the evacuation zone of- From South 40th Avenue, North to McCullough Road, East to the 1041 block of Red Sky Drive, then South to the Top of Athanum Ridge, then West to South 40th Avenue. Get your family and pets in your vehicles and leave now!
